about:
Cook Machinery, LLC operates from Clearwater, Florida, at 2632 Enterprise Road. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, and no founders are named in available materials.

The firm designs and builds thermal processing equipment for the citrus and juice industries. Its product line includes T.A.S.T.E. evaporators, citrus peel dryers, juice pasteurizers and deoilers, and waste heat evaporators. Details on facility size, headcount, or production volumes are not provided.

The equipment serves citrus processors, juice manufacturers, and food and beverage producers who need concentration, drying, pasteurization, and heat recovery systems. No specific customers are referenced.

The company has not published a stated point of differentiation or origin story.
